forbidden.body: The link you followed points to something that doesn't exist or that you can't open. If someone sent you the link, ask them to check it.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this

viewport.title: Use a larger screen

pending.title: {{name}}
pending.body: This screen is not built yet. It is part of the frontend plan.

auth.statusOnly: Researcher screens aren't open to you yet. Until your application is approved, you can only see your application status.

steps.title: How access works
steps.applySub: Tell us who you are and what you research.
steps.verifySub: Open the link we send you.
steps.reviewSub: Approve, decline with a reason, or ask a question.
steps.infoSub: Approve, decline with a reason, or ask a question.
steps.rejectedSub: A reason is always given. You can reply.
steps.enabledSub: Same account, no need to sign up again.

apply.title: Apply for researcher access
apply.lead: An administrator reviews every application before you can create projects. Fill in the fields marked Required. Everything else is optional.

placeholders.name: The name other researchers will see
placeholders.interests: Topics, collections or methods you work on
placeholders.biography: A few sentences about your background

hints.email: Private. We send a verification link here, and it's never shown on your profile unless you choose to show it.
hints.language: Sets the interface language. Your research content can be in Arabic, Sorani or English.
hints.affiliation: You don't need an academic affiliation to be approved.

errors.name: enter the name other researchers will see.
errors.email: enter a full address, like name@example.org.
errors.interests: add at least one research interest.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.lead: We sent a verification link to {{email}}.
checkEmail.expiry: The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
checkEmail.spam: Check your spam folder first. You can ask for a new link once a minute, up to 5 times a day.
checkEmail.sent: A new link is on its way. Use the most recent email.
checkEmail.dailyLimit: You've reached today's limit of 5 links. Try again tomorrow, or contact an administrator.

verify.checkingHint: This usually takes a second. Keep this page open.
verify.doneBody: Your application is in the review queue. We'll tell you when an administrator has decided.
verify.expiredBody: It has expired or was already used. Nothing changed in your application. Ask for a new link and use the most recent email.

signIn.mismatch: The email or password doesn't match
signIn.mismatchHint: Check both and try again. After 5 failed attempts, sign-in pauses for 15 minutes.
signIn.pausedBody_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
signIn.pausedBody_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
signIn.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact an administrator.
signIn.signedOutBody: This session ended or expired. Sign in again to continue. Unsaved editor text is kept as a local draft.

twoStep.title: Confirm it’s you
twoStep.body: This account has two-step sign-in. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoStep.wrongHint: Check the code in your authenticator app, or use a recovery code. This step expires after five minutes: if it has, start again.

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.lead: Enter the email you applied with. If it belongs to an account, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
recover.checkBody: If an account uses {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in 1 hour.
recover.tooMany_one: Too many reset requests in a short time. Try again in {{count}} minute.
recover.tooMany_other: Too many reset requests in a short time. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
recover.emailKept: Your email is still filled in.
recover.noEmailYet: Reset links are not delivered by email in this development build yet. Ask an administrator if you can't get in.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalidBody: It has expired or was already used. Request a new link.
reset.doneBody: You can sign in with your new password.

status.blockedTitle: Researcher screens aren't open to you yet.
status.blockedBody: You tried to open {{area}}. Until your application is approved, you can only see this status page.
status.pendingBody: An administrator will approve it, decline it with a reason, or ask you for more information. We'll email {{email}} when something changes.
status.infoTitle: An administrator asked for more information
status.replyKept: Your text is still here. Try sending it again.
status.keepAccount: We keep your account. If you're approved later, you'll use this same account, so there's no need to apply again.
status.reconsider: Reply and ask us to reconsider
status.approvedBody: Approved by a platform administrator on {{date}}. Your account is ready for research.
status.approvedBodyNoDate: Your account is ready for research.
status.suspendedBody: You can't use researcher screens while the account is suspended. Contact an administrator to ask why.
status.closureTitle: Your account closure request is with administrators
status.closureBody: An administrator will confirm the closure. Until then your research is kept and your account is limited to this page. Contact an administrator if you changed your mind.

home.startLead: Your account is ready. Most researchers begin in one of two ways. Everything you create stays private to you.
home.createProjectBody: Write down your research question and scope. You can keep as many projects as you need.
home.saveSourceBody: Save a book, chapter, report or narrator from the corpus, or add an external reference, to My Library.
home.projectsFailedBody: The server didn't respond in time. Your research is safe. Downloads and counts load separately.
home.nextActionsFailedTitle: Next actions couldn't be worked out
home.nextActionsFailedBody: They are based on your recent projects, which didn't load. Try again.
home.noNextActions: Nothing needs your attention right now.
home.noDownloads: No exports yet. Exports you start will appear here.
home.downloadsFailedBody: Your exports are not affected. Try again.

notAvailable.title: Project not available
notAvailable.body: This project doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it. We show the same message in both cases so private projects stay private.

index.title: Projects
index.countLine: {{active}} active · {{archived}} archived · {{trash}} in trash · all owned by you
index.countLineShared: {{shared}} shared with you · owned by others
index.filterFailedBody: The server didn't respond. Your filter “{{q}}” is kept. Try again, or clear it to see the last loaded list.
index.loadFailedBody: The server didn't respond. Your research is safe. Try again.

owned.title: No projects yet
owned.body: A project holds one investigation: a question, its scope, and everything you gather and write for it. You can have as many as you need, and each one is private and separate from the others.

shared.title: Nothing shared with you yet
shared.body: When a project owner invites you and you accept, the project appears here with your role. Shared projects never mix with your private library.

archived.title: No archived projects
archived.body: Archive a project to take it out of your active list without changing its stage. You can unarchive it at any time.

trash.title: Trash is empty
trash.body: Projects you move to trash stay here, read-only, for 30 days before they are deleted permanently.

filtered.title: No projects match
filtered.body: Nothing matches your search and filters. Clear them to see everything in this list.

firstSteps.question: A question
firstSteps.questionBody: What you're trying to find out, in a sentence.
firstSteps.workspaceBody: Resources, searches, evidence and writing, kept apart from other projects.
firstSteps.stagesBody: Scoping → Collecting → Analysing → Writing → Reviewing → Completed.

index.recovery: Projects in trash are read-only and can be restored for 30 days. After the date shown, they are deleted permanently. Your library items and other projects aren't affected.

row.archivedNote: Archiving doesn't mark a project completed. Its stage is kept as {{stage}}.

trashDialog.title: Move “{{title}}” to trash?
trashDialog.readOnly: It becomes read-only and leaves your project list.
trashDialog.restore: You can restore it until {{date}}. After that it's deleted permanently.
trashDialog.goesWith: {{evidence}} and {{findings}} go with it. Items saved in My Library stay.

leaveDialog.title: Leave “{{title}}”?
leaveDialog.body: You will lose access to this project. Anything you saved to My Library stays yours. The owner can invite you again.

create.title: New project
create.lead: Start with a question. You can change any of this later in project settings.
create.fixFields_one: Fix {{count}} field to create the project
create.fixFields_other: Fix {{count}} fields to create the project
create.keptNote: Everything else you entered is kept.

errors.title: enter a title.
errors.duplicate: this matches {{code}}. Titles must be unique among your projects.
errors.question: write the question this project will answer.
errors.scope: describe what is in and out of scope.

hints.direction: Direction is set for this field only. Auto follows the first strong character.
hints.languages: The languages your notes and writing will use. This is separate from the interface language.
hints.stage: You can move forwards or back later. Each change is logged.

placeholders.title: A short name for the investigation
placeholders.question: What are you trying to find out?
placeholders.scope: Which sources, periods and narrators are in. What is out.

create.forbiddenTitle: You can't create projects right now
create.forbiddenBody: Your account doesn't currently allow new projects. This happens while an application is pending or when an account is suspended. Your existing research is kept and you can still read it.

created.intro: Your new project is empty and separate. Nothing was copied from your other projects. Good first steps:
created.addResourcesHint: From My Library or the corpus
created.privateBody: Only you can see this project until you invite members. Making anything public always goes through a sharing preview.
created.separateBody: This project gets its own resources, searches, evidence and writing. To reuse material from another project, copy it from that project's Overview. The copy keeps a record of where it came from.

overview.question: Research question
overview.stageHelp: Click a stage to move. Moving back is allowed and goes in the activity log. Archiving is separate and lives in Settings.
overview.stageChanged: Stage changed from {{from}} to {{to}}{{back}}. Recorded in the activity log, {{when}}.
overview.stageFailed: The stage wasn't changed. Try again.
overview.emptyBody: Start by gathering sources and saving a search. Evidence counts, milestones and findings will appear here as you work.
overview.collectHint: From My Library or the corpus
overview.saveSearchHint: So you can rerun it and keep its results
overview.countsFailed: Counts couldn't be calculated. They're shown as Unknown, not zero. Your evidence is unchanged.
overview.reviewedNote: “Reviewed” means you have checked the item. It doesn't mean the report is authentic or correct.
overview.computedUnknown: Progress is calculated from project data; the basis isn't available yet.
overview.noNextActions: Nothing needs your attention right now.
overview.viewerNote: You can read this project. Only researchers and the owner can add to it.

settings.readOnly: Only the owner can change project settings. You can read them here.
settings.saveFailed: The details weren't saved. What you typed is kept.
settings.archiveBody: Takes it out of your active list. The stage stays {{stage}}. An unfinished project isn't marked Completed. You can unarchive at any time.
settings.unarchiveBody: Puts the project back in your active list. Its stage stays {{stage}}.
settings.transferBody: Choose an existing member. The new owner must accept the transfer. Available when members can join (R1b).
settings.trashBody: The project becomes read-only and can be restored for 30 days. {{evidence}}, {{findings}} and {{documents}} go with it. My Library isn't affected.

copy.title: Copy to another project
copy.noDestination: You have no other project to copy into. Create one first.
copy.none: Nothing to copy in this group.
copy.visibilityBody: Copies become visible to members of {{code}} (just you in R1a). Each copy records where it came from.
copy.neverCopiedList: Members and roles · private annotations · publication authority · activity history
copy.destinationNote: Changes in the destination never change this project.
copy.pickSomething: Choose at least one item and a destination.
copy.notCopied: {{label}} wasn't copied. Review it in this project, then try again.
copy.previewFailed: The preview couldn't be loaded. Try again.

picker.title: Add resource
picker.forbiddenTitle: You can't add resources to this project right now
picker.forbiddenBody: The project is read-only because it's in trash or archived, or your account can't make changes. You can still save to My Library.
picker.searchPlaceholder: A phrase, a title, a narrator's name, or an ID such as REP-000318
picker.searchHint: For full searches with filters, saved queries and result sets, use the Search workspace.
picker.searchFailedBody: The corpus index didn't respond. Your search “{{q}}” is kept. Try again in a moment.
picker.noMatchBody: This box matches report text, narrator names and IDs as written. Try fewer words, a different spelling, or a type filter. If the source isn't in the corpus, add it as an external reference.
picker.typeAtLeast: Type at least two characters to search.
picker.reportLevelText: The corpus records this wording for the report. Occurrence-specific wording is not recorded, so no variant is shown.
picker.noText: A narrator identity has no source text.

duplicate.title: Already in My Library
duplicate.body: Saved {{when}}{{as}}. Saving again won't duplicate it.
duplicate.reuse: Reuse the existing entry (add it to another collection or project)
duplicate.distinct: Save a distinct excerpt (pick a different page or span below)
duplicate.distinctNeeded: Choose a selected passage or a page range below first.
duplicate.reusedDone: Nothing new was saved. The existing entry is used.
duplicate.reusedAdded: The existing entry was added to the project.

what.title: What to save
what.itemSub: Saves the record and its locator.
what.spanSub: Select text in the source panel to save just that span, with its own locator.
what.noneSelected: Nothing selected yet. Select text in the source above.

saveTo.title: Save to
saveTo.librarySub: Only you. Available across all your projects.
saveTo.projectSub: Visible to project members (just you in R1a). Also saved to My Library.

external.lead: For an article, edition, manuscript or web page that isn't in the corpus. Fill in what you know. Anything left blank is marked as missing, never guessed.
external.author: Author(s)
external.missing: Missing: {{list}}. You can still save it. It will carry this flag everywhere it's cited until you fill the gaps.
external.complete: All citation details are filled in.
external.titleRequired: A title is needed to save

footer.needTitle: A title is needed to save
footer.flagged_one: Saves with an Incomplete citation flag ({{count}} missing)
footer.flagged_other: Saves with an Incomplete citation flag ({{count}} missing)

done.title: Saved
done.toProject: {{title}} was saved to My Library and added to {{code}} resources.

picker.failedKept: Your selection and entries are kept. Try again.

library.title: My Library

unavailable.title: That library item isn't available
unavailable.body: The link points to an item that doesn't exist or isn't in your library. Libraries are personal, so links to other researchers' libraries never open. Your own library is shown below.

empty.title: Your library is empty
empty.body: My Library keeps sources you want to come back to across all your projects. Saving here never changes the corpus, and removing something later never deletes the source.
empty.step1Body: Open any book, chapter, section, report, occurrence, chain, narrator or judgment and choose Save to My Library.
empty.step2Body: An article, manuscript or edition outside the corpus. Missing details are fine; they're flagged, not guessed.
empty.step3Body: Collections, tags, favourites and private notes. One item can sit in many collections.
empty.filtered: No saved items match these filters.
empty.filteredBody: Clear a filter or search for something else.

loadFailed.title: Your library couldn't be loaded
loadFailed.body: Nothing has been changed. Try again in a moment.

merged.title: Source changed · merged
merged.body: The corpus team merged this record into {{target}}. Your saved locator and the snapshot you saved are kept exactly as they were. Your notes and linked projects are unaffected.

changed.title: Source changed
changed.body: The corpus record changed after you saved it. Your saved locator and snapshot are kept as they were.

removedSource.title: Source removed from the corpus
removedSource.body: Your saved locator and snapshot are kept as they were.

library.noSnapshot: No source text was saved with this item.
library.inCollections: In {{collections}}. The item is stored once; collections only point to it.
library.inNoCollections: Not in any collection. The item is stored once; collections only point to it.

notes.heading: Private notes
notes.placeholder: A note only you can see
notes.author: Researcher note · {{name}}

usedIn.heading: Used in projects
usedIn.unavailable: Which projects use this item isn't shown yet.

remove.note: This removes only your library entry, tags and favourite. The corpus source and its use in projects stay as they are.
remove.title: Remove “{{title}}” from My Library?
remove.body: Your tags, favourite and private notes on this item are removed with it.
remove.kept: The corpus source and any project that already uses it stay as they are.

addProject.title: Add to project · {{id}}
addProject.noProjects: You have no projects you can add to yet.
addProject.excerptSub: The snapshot you saved with it
addProject.previewNote: This is exactly what project members will see.
addProject.previewFailed: The preview couldn't be loaded. You can still add; only the record is sure to be included.
addProject.alreadyIn: Already in this project. Adding again won't create a duplicate.
addProject.already: {{title}}: already in the project, nothing duplicated.
addProject.forbidden: {{title}}: not added. Your role in that project doesn't allow adding resources, or the project is in trash.
addProject.notFound: {{title}}: not added because the project could not be found.

projectResources.title: Resources
projectResources.heading: This project's resources
projectResources.intro: The sources this project relies on, with tags and reasons for inclusion that belong to {{id}} only. Other projects can't see them.
projectResources.separateBody: Your personal shelf across all projects. Adding from it copies only what you choose. Removing it here never touches your library, and removing it from your library never touches this project.

unavailable.title: That resource isn't available
unavailable.body: The link points to a resource that isn't in {{id}}. Resources belong to one project, so another project's ID can't open them here.

empty.title: No resources in this project yet
empty.body: Pick the sources this investigation needs from your library, or add straight from the corpus. Search results you keep will appear here too.

loadFailed.title: This project's resources couldn't be loaded
loadFailed.body: Nothing has been changed. Try again in a moment.

projectResources.collectionsUnavailable: Which resources are in a collection isn't shown yet.

detail.points: Points to corpus record {{code}}. The source is stored once and never copied.
detail.tagsEditUnavailable: Editing project tags isn't available yet.
detail.rename: Changing tags here doesn't change your personal tags or this source's tags in any other project.
detail.removeNote: Your library entry, other projects and the corpus source stay as they are.

removeDialog.title: Remove “{{title}}” from {{id}}?
removeDialog.tags: Project tags and the inclusion reason are removed with it.
removeDialog.kept: Your My Library entry and other projects are not affected.

fromLibrary.title: Add from My Library
fromLibrary.body: Pick the sources this project needs. Only the source record is copied; your tags and notes stay private.
fromLibrary.none: Everything in your library is already in this project.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Search the corpus for wording. Results are grouped by report record, with every occurrence underneath.

saved.heading: Saved searches
saved.noneBody: Save a search to rerun it later with the same text, filters and mode. Every run is recorded, so you can see what changed.
saved.scope: Project searches belong to this project and are visible to its members. Sharing a project search never exposes your personal ones.

unavailable.title: That saved search isn't available
unavailable.body: The link points to a search that doesn't exist or isn't in a scope you can open. Personal searches are never visible from projects, and project searches are only visible inside their project. A new, empty search is open instead.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.body: The saved definition is removed. Result sets already saved from its runs keep their members.

form.label: Search text
form.placeholder: Arabic wording to find, for example وضوء

modeHelp.exact: Matches the wording exactly as stored, including diacritics and spelling.
modeHelp.normalized: Ignores diacritics and spelling variants like ثلثا / ثلاثا.

filters.heading: Filters
filters.bookUnavailable: Filtering by book isn't available yet.
filters.coverage: How much of the corpus records each of these fields isn't shown yet, so a filter may leave out records that simply have no value.

whyValue.exact: The exact wording appears in the original text.
whyValue.normalized: Matched after ignoring diacritics and spelling variants.
whyValue.ranked: Matched by the full-text index, ranked by relevance.

results.noOccurrences: No occurrence is recorded for this report.
results.startBody: Enter the wording you are looking for. Nothing is saved until you choose to save the search or add results.
results.failedBody: Your query and filters are kept. Try again in a moment.
results.emptyBody: The search found no report records.
results.switchModeNote: , which ignores diacritics and spelling variants like ثلثا / ثلاثا.
results.stale: Showing the previous results while the new search runs.

selection.none: Select occurrences to add them to the project.
selection.readOnly: Your role in this project can read results but not add to it.

save.title: Save search
save.name: Name
save.namePlaceholder: A short name you will recognise
save.needText: Enter some text to search before saving it.

scope.label: Save to
scope.project: This project (its members can see it)
scope.projectUnavailable: Your role in this project cannot add to it.

save.savedMine: Saved to your Saved searches as {{code}}.

run.capped: Only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} matches were recorded. A recorded run is capped, so “Save all results” would not be complete.
run.saveAllOff: “Save all results” is turned off for a run that is not complete or was capped.

history.title: Run history · “{{name}}”
history.sub: Saved query {{code}} · project scope · every run is kept as its own record
history.empty: This saved search has not been run yet.
history.compareHint: Pick two runs to compare them.
history.setsFrozen: Result set {{code}}, saved from {{run}}, keeps exactly its {{count}} members. New runs never add to or remove from an earlier result set.

set.title: Save as result set
set.name: Name
set.limit: Result sets hold up to 5,000 members. They are never cut short silently.
set.fixed: Membership is fixed once saved. Later corpus changes or reruns won't add or remove items.

add.intro: Each selected occurrence is saved to My Library first (the source record only), then added to this project.
add.evidenceNote: New evidence starts as Candidate. Each item records the run it came from, the corpus version, you as collector, and the time.
add.saveFailed: This occurrence couldn't be saved to your library, so it was not added.

list.search: Search evidence text, locator or reason

loadFailed.title: Evidence couldn't be loaded
loadFailed.body: Nothing has been changed. Try again in a moment.

noMatch.title: No evidence matches
noMatch.body: Clear the filter or search for something else.

empty.title: No evidence yet
empty.body: Evidence is an exact passage or record you've captured for this project, with its locator and source version. Add it from search results, from a resource, or by selecting text in a source. It starts as Candidate, and you decide what to include.

unavailable.title: That evidence isn't available
unavailable.body: The link points to an evidence item that isn't in this project. Evidence belongs to one project, so another project's ID can't open it here.

inspector.normalizedUnavailable: The normalized form used for search isn't provided yet.
inspector.incompleteBody: No locator is recorded for this evidence. Citations from it will show “p. unknown” until it is filled in. It's never guessed. If you know it, propose a corpus correction.
inspector.originUnavailable: The search run or resource it was collected from isn't recorded yet.
inspector.pick: Select an evidence item to inspect its source, state, annotations and links.

tabs.label: Corpus detail
tabs.noCorpus: This source isn't a corpus record, so there is no chain or judgment to show.
tabs.loadFailed: The corpus record couldn't be loaded.
tabs.noChain: No chain is recorded for this report.
tabs.order: The narrator order is as the corpus stores it.
tabs.noJudgments: No ruling is recorded for any occurrence.

state.heading: State
state.note: Reviewed means checked by you. It doesn't mean authentic, correct or agreed.
state.reasonRequired: Excluded and Unresolved always need a reason. It is attributed to you and dated.
state.reasonOptional: Optional. It is attributed to you and dated.
state.usedIn_one: Used in {{formattedCount}} finding. It keeps the link and will show this evidence as {{state}}.
state.usedIn_other: Used in {{formattedCount}} findings. They keep the link and will show this evidence as {{state}}.
state.readOnly: Your role in this project can read evidence but not change its state.

history.heading: History
history.structuredUnavailable: Each change shows the server's own wording.

annotations.heading: Annotations
annotations.privacy: Only annotations you may see are listed. Other authors' private annotations are never shown here, in search, in document links or in exports, including to project owners.
annotations.attributedRequired: A judgment needs the scholar it is attributed to and where it is stated.
annotations.attributionLost: The annotation was saved, but the server did not keep who it is attributed to or where it is stated.
annotations.readOnly: Your role in this project cannot add annotations.

findings.heading: Linked findings
findings.interpretation: How it bears on the finding (optional)
findings.note: The same evidence can support one finding and oppose another. Its source isn't duplicated.
findings.noFindings: This project has no findings yet.

correction.title: Propose a correction to the corpus
correction.explanationHint: Say what the evidence shows, in at least 10 characters.
correction.note: Your proposal goes to the corpus editors' queue, which is separate from this project. Nothing in the corpus changes until an editor accepts it, and accepting it inside a project never changes the canonical record.
correction.sent: Proposal {{code}} sent to the corpus editors.
correction.noRecord: This evidence doesn't point to a corpus record, so a correction can't be proposed from it.

remove.title: Remove “{{title}}” from this project?
remove.plain: This removes the evidence item and its annotations. It can't be undone.
remove.kept: Earlier document versions keep their quoted text unchanged. Consider marking it Excluded with a reason instead.

comparison.title: Comparison workspace

bar.notSaved: Not saved. Saving stores this comparison as a new version.
bar.dossierNote: A dossier is read from the corpus and isn’t stored.

run.title: {{kind}} · v{{version}}
run.inputsUnreadable: The inputs of this analysis aren't stored in a form this screen can use, so it can't be opened in the workspace or run again.
run.corpusNote: The corpus can change after an analysis is stored. This server doesn't say whether it did, so to check, run it again and compare.
run.openInputs: Open its inputs in the workspace
run.againNote: Running it again stores a new version and leaves this one as it is.

unavailable.title: Analysis not available
unavailable.body: This analysis doesn't exist in this project, or one of its inputs belongs to a project you can't open. We show the same message in both cases. Nothing about the other project is revealed.

stored.title: Stored in another format
stored.body: This analysis was stored in a shape the comparison views don't draw. It is shown exactly as stored, and nothing has been added to it.

occ.title: Select occurrences to compare
occ.body: Pick 2 to 6 reports from this project's evidence or from the corpus. Each column shows its source and original wording. Where wording is missing, you get a limitation notice, never invented variants.

chains.title: Select chains to compare
chains.body: Pick reports from evidence or the corpus. Their chains are shown side by side, from the compiler to the earliest source. Narrators who are in every chain are marked.

dossier.title: Choose a narrator
dossier.body: Find a narrator by name to see their record, who they heard from and taught, and what critics said.

crit.title: Choose a narrator
crit.body: Pick a narrator to see what different critics said about them, in their exact words.

select.title: Select inputs
select.hint: Choose {{min}} to {{max}} reports. Chains are taken from the same reports.
select.noEvidence: This project has no evidence from the corpus yet.
select.search: Search the corpus for a report

occ.missing: {{code}} isn't in the corpus, so it is left out.

tooFew.title: Two reports are needed
tooFew.body: Comparing needs at least two reports that the corpus has.

occ.limited: The corpus has no wording for this report yet. No variants are shown, because they would have to be invented.
occ.noMarks: The wording couldn't be matched word by word with the comparison, so it is shown without marks.

form.noVersion: No saved version yet, so it cannot be included.
form.findings_one: All {{formattedCount}} finding of the project is included. The platform cannot include only some of them.
form.findings_other: All {{formattedCount}} findings of the project are included. The platform cannot include only some of them.
form.findingsUnknown: All the project's findings are included. Their number could not be loaded.
form.title: Title
form.abstractHint: What you studied and what you found, in a few sentences. This is what editors and reviewers read first.
form.noAuthors: Listing authors with their consent is not available yet: the platform does not record it. Only the submitting owner is named.
form.rightsConfirm: I confirm that quoted source passages are within what the source rights allow, and that everyone credited agreed to be credited.
form.coiConfirm: I have declared every conflict of interest relevant to this work.
form.rightsNote: The platform does not check source rights for you. Your confirmation is recorded with the package.

check.title: 4 · Check before you submit
check.choose: Choose a document to see what needs fixing.
check.failed: The check could not be run, so nothing can be submitted now.
check.clean: Nothing to fix. The package passed the check.
check.cannot_one: Cannot submit yet: {{count}} thing to fix
check.cannot_other: Cannot submit yet: {{count}} things to fix
check.canWithNotes: Can be submitted. Please read the notes.

codes.NO_DOCUMENTS: The package includes no documents. Only the findings and the project's details would be included.
codes.DOCUMENT_NO_VERSION: A document in the package has no saved version.
codes.UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE_DEPENDENCY: A citation points to evidence that is still unresolved. Resolve it, or choose a different citation.
codes.INTERNAL_PRIVATE_LINK: A document contains a link into the private workspace. Convert it to a public citation or remove it.
codes.SUSPENDED_PARTICIPANT: A project member is suspended. Their credit or access must be settled first.

respond.title: Revisions were requested
respond.hint: Answer the editor's points one by one. It is kept with the new package.

freeze.title: Freeze this package and submit?
freeze.what: A fixed copy is made of {{documents}} document(s) at their latest saved version and the project's {{findings}} findings.
freeze.keepWorking: You can keep working in the project. Later edits do not change this package.
freeze.notPublic: Nothing is public until an editor approves this exact package and releases it.

packages.title: Packages
packages.noneBody: When you freeze and submit a package it is listed here, with its status.
packages.note: Each package is frozen once it is submitted. An editor's decision belongs to the package it was made on.

editorial.title: Submissions
editorial.noneBody: Packages that researchers submit for publication appear here.
editorial.noneFilteredBody: Widen the filters, or clear them.

case.unavailableBody: It may not exist, or you may not have editorial access.
case.conflicted: You cannot decide on this submission or assign its reviewers: you are its owner or its submitter. It needs another editor.
case.response: Authors' response to the last review:
case.nothingToDo: Nothing is waiting on an editor for this package.

assign.title: Assign a reviewer
assign.intro: A reviewer reads this package only. Candidates with a conflict cannot be chosen.
assign.failedList: The candidates could not be loaded.
assign.dueHint: Leave empty for 14 days from now.
assign.coi: I know of no conflict of interest between me and this choice.
assign.note: The platform asks the reviewer nothing: it records the assignment, and the reviewer sees it in their own list.

decide.title: Decision on {{code}}
decide.needsReview: Needs at least one finished review.
decide.notes: Reason or message to the authors
decide.notesHint: At least {{min}} characters. The authors read this.
decide.coi: I confirm I have no conflict of interest with this submission.
decide.approveNote: Approving does not publish. Release is a separate step.

approve.title: Approve {{code}}?
approve.body: The package becomes approved. Nothing is public until it is released.

request_revisions.title: Request revisions on {{code}}?
request_revisions.body: The authors see your message and can answer with a new package.

reject.title: Reject {{code}}?
reject.body: The authors see your reason. The platform has no way to submit the project again from there.

release.title: Release {{code}}
release.approved: This package is approved and not yet public.
release.body: Releasing creates the public page for this exact package. Check the address and the version.
release.slugHint: Letters, numbers and single hyphens. It must not be used by another publication.
release.slugInvalid: use letters, numbers and single hyphens, with no spaces
release.doiHint: If you leave it empty the platform makes an internal identifier. That is not a registered DOI and must not be cited as one.

corrigendum.title: Add a correction notice
corrigendum.body: The notice is public. The publication moves from version {{version}} to the new one.
corrigendum.versionSame: choose a version different from the current one

retract.title: Retract this publication
retract.body: The page stays public, marked as retracted, with your reason. This cannot be undone from here.
retract.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is shown publicly.

review.title: Peer review
review.intro: Packages you have been asked to review. You see only the frozen package, never the project it came from.
review.noneBody: When an editor asks you to review a package, it appears here.
review.unavailableBody: It may not exist, or it may not be assigned to you.

gate.title: Before you open the package
gate.intro: Say whether you can review this package fairly. You have a conflict of interest if you:

items.coauthor: have worked with the authors on a publication or a project
items.institution: share an institution or a close working relationship with them
items.supervision: have supervised them, or been supervised by them
items.financial: have a financial interest in the work
items.other: know of any other reason you could not be impartial

gate.confirm: I know of no conflict of interest and I can review this package impartially.
gate.note: If any of these applies, decline instead: the editor will ask someone else. The platform records only whether you declared no conflict.

decline.title: Decline this review?
decline.body: The assignment is removed from your list and the editor can ask someone else. It cannot be undone from here.

package.included: Included in this package: {{documents}} document(s), {{findings}} finding(s), {{citations}} citation(s).
package.notIncluded: Project notes, discussions, tasks and private annotations are not included.

form.title: Your review
form.notesHint: At least {{min}} characters. This goes to the editor, who decides.
form.note: Your recommendation goes to the editor. The editor makes the decision. The platform has no separate comment for the authors, and cannot say whether you may be named.

confirm.title: Submit your review?
confirm.body: It is sent to the editor and cannot be changed from here afterwards.

sent.title: Your review was sent
sent.note: The editor decides. You can still read the package.

publications.title: Published research
publications.intro: Studies that were reviewed, approved and released by the editors. Announcements of work in progress are listed separately.
publications.tag: Published research · released by the editors
publications.noneBody: Released studies will be listed here.
publications.noneFilteredBody: Try another spelling, such as wudu or الوضوء, or remove a filter.
publications.scope: Search covers released publications only. Private projects, drafts and submissions under review are never listed.

gone.title: Nothing has been published at this address
gone.body: Submissions under review, or approved but not yet released, are not public, even with the link.

publications.reviewNone: No review is recorded for this release.
publications.foot: This page shows the released version only. Project discussions, notes and unpublished drafts are not public. Reviewers are not named.

retracted.title: Retracted {{date}}.
retracted.note: This is no longer an active, approved finding. The text below is kept for the record and is marked as retracted.

cite.title: Cite this
cite.otherFormat: The platform answered in {{format}} for this request.
cite.failed: The citation could not be loaded.

alignment.title: Matn alignment
alignment.sub: Align the wording of two to six reports, word by word, against one of them.
alignment.automatic: The alignment is made automatically from the words of each text. It has not been checked by a researcher, and a difference here describes the wording, not whether a text is sound.

empty.title: Choose at least 2 texts
empty.body: Alignment compares the wording of two or more reports word by word. Pick reports from this project's evidence, or find them in the corpus.

alignment.missing: These reports could not be found in the corpus and were left out: {{ids}}.
alignment.loadFailed: Some reports could not be loaded. The alignment shown is of the ones that did.
alignment.withoutText: These reports have no wording in the corpus, so they were left out rather than shown as entirely omitted: {{ids}}.
alignment.notAlignment: This stored analysis is not an alignment in the form this screen can draw.
alignment.legend: The words are shown as the platform aligned them: diacritics removed and letter forms unified. = same word · ~ different word at the same place · + a word only in this text · ∅ a word only in the baseline. These are differences in wording, not marks of error.
alignment.identical: No differences: every word is the same as in the baseline.
alignment.nothingAligned: Nothing was aligned for this text.

summary.label: What was counted
summary.percent: {{percent}}% of aligned places have the same word

alignment.readOnly: You can look at alignments here. Saving one needs a role that can add shared research.

saved.title: Saved alignments
saved.none: No alignment has been saved in this project.

isnad.title: Isnād graph
isnad.sub: The chains of two to six reports drawn as one graph of narrators, with arrows from teacher to student.
isnad.unchecked: The graph is built from the narrators the corpus lists for each chain, and its reading direction and its narrator links have not been checked by a researcher. A narrator it marks as a candidate common link is picked by a rule of thumb, not shown to be one.
isnad.graphLabel: Transmission graph. The same narrators and links are in the table below.

empty.title: Choose at least 2 reports
empty.body: The graph is built from the isnād of two or more reports. Pick reports from this project's evidence, or find them in the corpus.

isnad.fewChains: The chosen reports have {{count}} chain(s) recorded; a graph needs at least two.
isnad.missing: These reports could not be found in the corpus and were left out: {{ids}}.
isnad.loadFailed: Some reports could not be loaded. The graph is of the chains of the ones that did.
isnad.truncated: Only the first {{max}} of {{total}} chains are drawn.
isnad.notGraph: This stored analysis is not a graph in the form this screen can draw.
isnad.arrows: Arrows point from teacher to student. The number on a line is how many of the chains use that link.

candidates.title: Candidate common links
candidates.none: No narrator is picked by the rule: none has two or more students in these chains, and none is on most of them.
candidates.line: on {{chains}} chain(s), with {{students}} student(s) in these chains
candidates.rule: The rule: a narrator with two or more students in the chains, or on at least 70% of them. It says where chains branch or gather. It does not say the narrator is the common link, and it does not weigh how the chains were collected.

panel.title: The narrator in focus
panel.pick: Choose a narrator in the graph or the table to see their links.
panel.through: Show only the chains through this narrator

chains.title: The chains
chains.failed: The chains could not be listed.
chains.note: Each chain reads from the narrator nearest the compiler to the earliest source, as the corpus lists them.

isnad.readOnly: You can look at graphs here. Saving one needs a role that can add shared research.

saved.title: Saved graphs
saved.none: No graph has been saved in this project.

families.title: Hadith families
families.sub: Reports that share a core, grouped by you, with the relationship each one has to the family.
families.unchecked: The platform suggests no members: there is no matcher behind this screen. Everything here was added by a researcher, and a family cannot be edited or deleted once it is made.
families.readOnly: You can read the families of this project; adding to them is for members who can edit shared work.

empty.title: No families yet
empty.body: Start a family when two or more reports seem to share a core, then add each report with the relationship you judge it to have.

list.title: Families
list.pick: Choose a family to see its members.
list.notFound: That family is not in this project.

new.title: New family
new.companionHint: Optional. The Companion the reports are traced to.

add.title: Add a member
add.reportHint: The number of the report in the corpus. It is looked up before it is added.
add.reportNumber: Enter the report number, digits only.
add.relationshipHint: Your judgement. Choose Candidate if you have not classified it yet.
add.narratorHint: Optional. The narrator at which this report meets the family.
add.depthInvalid: Use a whole number, or leave it empty.
add.notesHint: Optional. Why you placed it here.
add.already: That is already a member of this family.

detail.noReviewed: No member has been classified yet.
detail.limits: Families cannot be renamed or deleted after they are made, and the relationships above are the server's fixed set.

remove.title: Remove {{code}} from this family?
remove.body: The report itself is not deleted; only its place in this family.

ilal.title: ʿIlal cases
ilal.sub: Compare versions of a report, record what critics said, and keep your conclusion.
ilal.unchecked: The platform grades nothing. A case holds what researchers entered: the versions, the critics' words as typed in, and a preference between versions. Objections, replies and a change history are not stored yet.
ilal.readOnly: You can read the cases of this project; changing them is for members who can edit shared work.

empty.title: No cases yet
empty.body: Start a case when two versions of a report, chain or wording disagree. Then add the versions and what critics said about them.

list.title: Cases
list.pick: Choose a case to read it.
list.notFound: That case is not in this project.

categories.waqf_vs_raf: Stopped vs raised to the Prophet (waqf / rafʿ)
categories.ziyadah_thiqah: Addition by a trusted narrator (ziyādat al-thiqa)

new.title: New case
new.categoryHint: The server's fixed list of kinds.

variant.title: Add a version
variant.name: Name
variant.nameHint: Short, to tell the versions apart, e.g. “Version A”.
variant.nameTaken: Another version already has this name.
variant.chainHint: Optional. The chain as you write it.

critic.title: Record a critic’s statement
critic.saidHint: Type it as written; the platform does not check it against the book.
critic.sourceHint: Optional. The book and place, e.g. al-ʿIlal 1/42.
critic.favoursHint: Optional. The version the statement supports.

detail.noVersions: No versions yet. Add at least two to compare.
detail.needTwo: Add a second version to compare, and before a preference can be recorded.
detail.notAGrade: This records the researchers’ preference between versions. It is not an authenticity grade for the report.
detail.strayPreferred: The preferred version stored for this case does not match any version above:
detail.limits: Versions and statements cannot be edited or removed once added, and a case cannot be deleted. Two people saving at the same moment can overwrite each other’s conclusion.

conclusion.notesHint: Why you prefer it, and what stays unresolved.
conclusion.needTwo: Two versions are needed before a case can be concluded.

narrator.title: Narrator dossier
narrator.choose: Look a narrator up by name to open their dossier.
narrator.unchecked: The identity and the critics' words come from the corpus as recorded. What the project holds about this narrator is what researchers entered. The platform computes no verdicts and no checks of whether two narrators could have met.

categories.mudallis_from_him: Conceals the link (tadlīs) from this teacher

assertions.title: What this project holds about the narrator
assertions.note: Dates and facts as the researchers state them, with alternatives kept beside each. A claim is free text: it has no date field and no source field of its own.
assertions.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Add a claim such as a death year, and put its source in the text.
assertions.claimHint: For example “died in 197 AH (Ibn Ḥajar, Taqrīb)”.
assertions.adjudicationHint: Why one reading is preferred, or why they stay open.
assertions.cannotClear: Once written, this can be changed but not emptied: the server ignores empty values.
assertions.deleteBody: The claim and its alternatives are removed from the project. Other claims are not touched.

assessments.title: Assessments by teacher
assessments.note: What critics said about this narrator's reports from one particular teacher. They are recorded here only; the comparison workspace and the isnād graph do not use them yet.
assessments.teacherNone: Not chosen yet. Look the teacher up below.
assessments.textHint: Type it as written; the platform does not check it against the book.

criticism.title: What critics said (general)
criticism.note: From the corpus, word for word. The first page only.
criticism.none: The corpus records no statements for this narrator.
criticism.failed: The statements could not be loaded.

trajectory.title: Places
trajectory.note: Shared geographic records, the same for every project. Read only here.
trajectory.failed: The places could not be loaded.

books.title: Book structure and terms
books.choose: Choose a collection to read its chapters or look up a word form in it.
books.unchecked: Counts are the corpus server's own and are shown as given. Where a result is a sample, or a word form is not found, the page says so; neither is a proof that something is absent. The critic-expression index, corpus snapshots and licence notices of the design are not available yet.

contents.totals: {{chapters}} chapters · {{occurrences}} occurrences. Chapters are listed in the order the server stores them, with the titles as printed.
contents.pick: Choose a chapter to read its reports.
contents.notFound: That chapter is not in this book.

chapter.none: No reports were returned for this chapter.
chapter.note: An occurrence is one hadith entry in the edition. The list shows each report once, so it can be shorter than the count when a report stands more than once in the chapter.

words.title: Word forms
words.termHint: 2 to 100 characters. Vowel marks are ignored.
words.scopeAll: Searching every collection of the corpus.
words.start: Enter a word form to see where it appears.
words.noneBody: “{{term}}” was not found in this scope. That is not a confirmed absence: the search is on the corpus text as indexed.
words.atLeast_one: {{n}} place returned, the most the server was asked for. There may be more.
words.atLeast_other: {{n}} places returned, the most the server was asked for. There may be more.
words.byBookNote: Counts only the places returned above, not every place in the collection.
words.notLocated: The word form was not located in this text; the start of the text is shown instead.

argument.title: Argument map
argument.sub: The points of the project's reasoning and how they answer one another.
argument.unchecked: Everything here was written by researchers. The platform does not judge an argument. The server keeps one map for the whole project; the design draws one per finding, so you can narrow this one to the points connected to a finding. A removed point is gone for good: there is no history yet.
argument.readOnly: You can read the map; adding to it is for members who can edit shared work.
argument.loops: These points answer each other in a loop, so they cannot be placed in the outline. Open one and remove a relation to break the loop:
argument.pick: Choose a point to read it.
argument.notFound: That point is not in the map shown.
argument.graphNote: The graph repeats the outline. Choose a point in either to change it.

empty.title: No argument structure yet
empty.body: Start with the claim, then add supporting points, objections, replies, qualifications and alternative conclusions. Each point can link to the evidence behind it.

source.title: Source behind this point
source.none: This point is reasoning only, with no source linked.

actions.answer: Add a point that answers this

point.typeHint: Choosing a kind suggests how it relates to the point it answers.
point.title: Short title
point.evidenceHint: Optional. Without one, the point is shown as reasoning only.
point.cannotUnlink: It can be changed to another, but not emptied: the server ignores empty values.
point.linkFailed: The point was added, but linking it to the point it answers failed. It now stands as a top point; link it again from its page.

relation.title: Make “{{title}}” answer another point
relation.loop: That would make the points answer each other in a loop.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.body: The point and its relations are removed for good. Points that answered it stay and become top points. The evidence it links to is not touched.

export.saved: Saved {{file}}: {{points}} points and {{relations}} relations. It does not carry the evidence links, notes or removed points.

searchCompare.title: Search run comparison and schedules
searchCompare.sub: See what a saved query found newly, lost, or kept between two runs, and choose whether to be told about it.
searchCompare.unchecked: The lists are the server's: records in the later run only, in the earlier run only, and in both. A record that changed its wording or place is not detected as changed, and the platform does not say whether the corpus itself changed beyond the version each run recorded.

noQueries.title: No saved queries yet
noQueries.body: Save a search and run it more than once to compare its runs.

searchCompare.needTwo_zero: This query has no completed run to compare.
searchCompare.needTwo_one: This query has one completed run. Run it again to compare.
searchCompare.pickRuns: Choose an earlier and a later run.
searchCompare.queryEdited: The saved query was edited between the two runs, so some differences come from the edit and not from the corpus.
searchCompare.corpusChanged: The corpus version changed between the runs ({{from}} to {{to}}), so some differences may come from the corpus and not from the query.
searchCompare.corpusUnknown: One of the runs did not record its corpus version, so a change in the corpus cannot be ruled out.

lists.removed: No longer in the later run

empty.added: No record is new in the later run.
empty.kept: No record is in both runs.

searchCompare.recordUnavailable: The text of this record could not be loaded.
searchCompare.footnote: Records are listed once each, by their corpus number. The wording is the corpus text now.

schedule.title: Alerts about this query
schedule.notRunning: The server keeps this choice but does not rerun the query or send alerts yet. Saving it records your wish only; each run is still started by a person.
schedule.none: You are not subscribed to this query.
schedule.readOnly: Subscribing is for members who can edit shared work.

templates.title: Project templates
templates.sub: Start a new private project from a template, with its starting question and tasks.
templates.limits: A template only adds a starting question and starting tasks. It adds no evidence, gradings or conclusions, and everything can be changed or deleted after the project is created.

empty.title: No templates are published
empty.body: This server has no project templates yet. You can still start a blank project.

templates.unusable: This template cannot be used now: one of its starting tasks has no title.

form.label: New project from {{title}}
form.title: New project from “{{title}}”
form.projectTitleHint: It must differ from the titles of your other projects.
form.duplicate: You already have a project with this title ({{code}}).
form.question: Research question
form.questionHint: Starts as the template's question. Change it to yours.
form.languageHint: The project's other languages can be added later.
form.afterwards: The project is private to you. Its scope is set by the server to say it came from this template; write your own in the project's settings.

exchange.title: Other exports and importing a package
exchange.sub: What can be saved or brought in beyond the ZIP of your data on the Downloads page.

graph.title: Argument map structure
graph.what: Saves a project's argument map as one JSON file: each point with its title, kind and text, and each relation with its kind. Programs that read graphs can open it.
graph.notIncluded: The file does not carry the evidence or finding a point is linked to, notes on relations, the order of points, who wrote them, or removed points. It is JSON only; there is no GraphML file.
graph.noProjects: You have no project to export from.
graph.projectsFailed: Your projects could not be loaded.

docx.title: Word document (DOCX)
docx.unavailable: Not available yet. The server accepts a request for a Word document but makes the same ZIP of JSON files whatever format is asked for, so no Word file is offered here.

import.title: Import a package
import.unavailable: Not available yet. The server's import reads the title from a package and makes an empty project: it keeps none of the package's evidence, findings, documents or argument, and it does not check the package. It is not offered here so nothing looks imported that was not.

referenceImport.title: Import references
referenceImport.sub: Bring in references from your reference manager. Nothing is saved until you have looked at the list.

refs.title: BibTeX or RIS file
refs.note: The file is read in your browser and each reference you keep is saved to My Library, private to you. A reference that is already in your library is left as it is, never overwritten.
refs.fileHint: .bib, .ris or a text file, up to 2 MB.
refs.pasteHint: BibTeX entries starting with @book{…} or RIS records starting with TY  -.

referenceImport.tooBig: That file is larger than {{max}}. Split it and import the parts.
referenceImport.readFailed: The file could not be read.

unreadable.title: This can’t be read as BibTeX or RIS.
unreadable.body: The first line is “{{line}}”. A BibTeX file starts with @book{… and a RIS file with “TY  -”. Export from your reference manager as BibTeX or RIS and try again.

referenceImport.noEntries: The file is BibTeX, but it holds no references to import.
referenceImport.tooMany: {{count}} references is more than the {{max}} that can be imported at once. Split the file.

problems.noTitle: Has no title, so it is left out

referenceImport.neverOverwrites: Entries without a title are left out. A reference you already have is reported and kept as it is.

result.title: Import result
result.duplicate_one: {{count}} was already in your library and was left as it is.
result.duplicate_other: {{count}} were already in your library and were left as they are.
result.tagged: Saved references carry the tag “import” and the date, so you can find them together.

uploads.title: Upload a file
uploads.unavailable: Not available yet. The server has no way to receive files (scans, articles, data) or to check them for malware, so no upload is offered here. Your references can still be imported from BibTeX or RIS above.

unavailable.title: Datasets are not available yet
unavailable.body: A dataset here would be a fixed table of records chosen by rules you set, released in versions with a data dictionary and a check of what may be redistributed. The server has no place to keep datasets yet, so nothing can be built, saved or released, and this page shows no example.

meanwhile.title: What you can do now
meanwhile.setsText: from a search to keep the records you chose, exactly as they were found.
meanwhile.zipText: as a ZIP of JSON files.

public.title: Nothing is published here
public.body: Public dataset and dossier pages are not available yet. Published research can be read in the research listing.
